name: com.citestamp/citestamp
title: CiteStamp
description: Check that a reference resolves; see what supports, refutes or cites a paper. CC0 graph, read-only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Anonymous access works at 10 req/min per IP; send Authorization: Bearer <key> to raise the limit (free key by email to info@citestamp.com = 60/min, Pro = 600/min).
